values.subject: Onboarding health information processing scope and hiring workflow confirmation
values.body_text: After HR, legal, and information security review: this onboarding assessment does not receive the original physical-examination report, clinic records, medication history, health-app screenshots, or physician contacts. If the candidate gives separate written consent, the Hanyu Health onboarding team may receive one file containing only a fitness-for-general-office-work conclusion; Anheng Consulting is not a recipient. The file is used only for this hiring assessment and deleted within 30 days after the hiring decision; the candidate may withdraw consent before processing. This scope does not change the offer intent; the candidate alone confirms acceptance and start date.
